parameters.content:
## Look at pages (tool: look_at_pages)
Fetches the page images from the local vision service (a sheet comes as overview + all 12 tiles) and shows them to **gpt-5.4-mini** (Azure, US Data Zone) with the question.
**Two passes:** if a precise reading needs a closer look (a value off a chart, tiny text), the model asks for a region; the service crops and enlarges it and the model reads again. Only the short answer goes back to the agent.
A **failed read** is not a reading: a first look that is cut off by the 6000-token budget, empty or failed tells the agent so; a failed zoom pass (cut off, empty, crop or call failed) returns the first-look draft marked approximate. Each logs an incident with the error reporter (*Log incident*).
